_provenance.what: Server-side venue catalog used to recompute every order price (ADR-0008: never trust a client amount).
_provenance.source: https://cvm-pwa.orangesync.tech/menu.json (deployed by scripts/cvm-deploy-catalog.sh; the file the shipped PWA at /order/ fetches as ../menu.json)
_provenance.sha256_note: sha256 of the captured menu.json this catalog was generated from; step 5 of the deploy script asserts the deployed file matches.
_provenance.how: tools/capture_menu.py (live ContextVM round trip) | scripts/cvm-deploy-catalog.sh (generate, never hand-edit)
_provenance.note: Prices are mirror-captured from the venue CVMs' live menu events; if a venue menu changes, re-run the deploy script rather than editing this file.

_rate_note: 1 EUR = 1000 sats, matching the shipped PWA's own display rate (app.js: `sats = n => Math.round(n * 1000)`). Override with SATS_PER_EUR in the service env.
_option_note: Mirrored from the shipped client (app.js: Bacon .15, Jalapeños .09, Extra cheese .12 EUR). The venue CVMs' option_group_ids are not priced in the captured menu, so a client-sent option token that is not in this table is recorded but charged nothing; see REPORT.md 'what this does NOT prove'.
